result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional description, and it comes back from all six listing and lookup methods. The full test suite passes offline, including a new test for the description behaviour. Nothing is committed.

What changed:

- **`model/Promotion.java`**: added a `description` component to the record. It is null when none was given.
- **`schema.sql`**: added a nullable `description VARCHAR(200)` column to `promotion`.
- **`service/PromotionService.java`**: added a six-argument `createPromotion(..., category, description)`. A null or blank description is stored as null, the same way blank categories are handled. The existing five-argument method still works and passes null, so the current callers and tests are unchanged.
- **`DataStore.java`**: the insert now writes the description. The row mapper and all six promotion `SELECT`s (by code, active on a date, active in a region, by category, best for category on a date, unused in a period) now read it.
- **`PromotionTest.java`**: added `returnsDescriptionWhenGivenAndNoneOtherwise`. It creates a promotion with a description and one without, then checks the text in the active, category, and unused listings. It does not call the by-code lookup or the best-for-category method directly, although both use the same row mapper.

I did not add a description to the demo data in `DemoScenario`.
